card_text:
Relation: head of government
Angela Merkel is head of government of Germany.
Fumio Kishida is head of government of Japan.
Justin Trudeau is head of government of Canada.
Narendra Modi is head of government of India.

Relation: exact-match mapping
SKU 1001 maps to catalog item 1001.
ISO alpha-2 US maps to United States.
Record A-17 resolves to canonical record A-17.

Relation: same canonical identifier
Alias Q42 resolves to entity Q42.
The normalized key and stored key are identical.
Both references select the same row.

Relation: component of
A wheel is a component of a bicycle.
A chapter is a component of a book.
A processor core is a component of a CPU.

Relation: member of collection
A track belongs to an album.
A file belongs to a directory.
A district belongs to a city.

Relation: authored by
Frankenstein was authored by Mary Shelley.
The paper was authored by its listed researchers.
The module was authored by the commit signer.

Relation: attributed to
The photograph is attributed to the studio.
The quotation is attributed to its speaker.
The design is attributed to the named architect.

Relation: associated operationally with
The contractor is associated operationally with the agency.
The sensor is associated operationally with the platform.
The report is associated operationally with the program.

Relation: supports
The team supports the service.
The bracket supports the shelf.
The evidence supports the conclusion.

Relation: represents
The icon represents the application.
The delegate represents the district.
The record represents a physical shipment.

Relation: linked to
The citation is linked to a source.
The account is linked to a device.
The station is linked to the main line.
